$Comment: An example caster roster that ships switched off: with Enabled false it arms nothing. Switched on, it arms the Ember Dragon (role Dragon_Fire) with three entries. Each is gated by Scope BOSS, so it fires only while the dragon is a member of the Mmoscaling_Bosses group, as it ships. The first casts MMO Skill Tree's fireball on a slow cadence, after a wind-up: the dragon's own 'Hurt' flinch stands in for a cast animation, which its model does not have. The second arms this mod's Mmoscaling_Demo_Dodge attack once at spawn, so the dragon dodges now and then in a fight; a NativeChain entry arms once, so its CadenceSeconds and JitterSeconds do nothing. The third casts dragon_arcana (Draconic Arcana in game), the Goblin Duke's ice ball with a knockback, more rarely than the fireball; its throw animation was made for a goblin and may not play on the dragon. To switch it on, copy this file into your own content pack at the same path, Server/MmoMobScaling/CasterRosters/Demo_Boss_Caster.json, set Enabled to true, and list Ziggfreed:MmoMobScaling under Dependencies in the pack's manifest.json (without it, this mod's copy loads after yours and keeps the example off). To arm a different mob, copy it under a new file name instead: point Role at one role with Id or at a family with Glob, and tune each entry with CadenceSeconds, JitterSeconds, MinDifficulty, Rarities and Scope.
